english.note: Use this when a work is partly based on reality but contains invented elements.

examples.english: This film, which is partly based on real events but contains fictional elements, is quite enjoyable.
examples.traditional: 呢套根據真人真事改編、帶有虛構成分嘅電影幾好睇。
